analyzed_vuln.description: In ReadPSInfo(), when parsing DocumentCustomColors / CMYKCustomColor / SpotColor records, the code reads bytes into a stack buffer `char name[MagickPathExtent]` until whitespace, then calls `ConstantString(name)`. The loop only stops on `isspace(c)` or full buffer, but `isspace(c)` is invoked on raw `int c` from input without casting to unsigned char. For non-ASCII bytes (e.g. 0xCB,0x90 in the PoC), `isspace(c)` can return true unexpectedly under locale/UB behavior, causing an early break before any byte is stored; then `name[0]` is left uninitialized except for `name[i]='\0'` at current i, and later `ConstantString(name)` calls strlen on non-NUL stack data, producing an out-of-bounds stack read (ASan at strlen -> ConstantString -> SetImageProperty). Crash site is in ConstantString/strlen, but root cause is unsafe token parsing and ctype use in ReadPSInfo.
analyzed_vuln.conditions: Trigger via EPS/PS input reaching ReadPSInfo() and matching one of the color-comment prefixes so execution enters the name-reading block. Provide crafted non-ASCII bytes around the token so the `isspace(c)` check on signed/raw byte misbehaves and the parsed `name` string is not safely initialized as a proper C string before `ConstantString(name)`. Data flow: ping_eps_fuzzer -> ReadPSImage -> ReadPSInfo -> SetImageProperty/ConstantString -> strlen OOB read.
